exposure: Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) patterns (Small AUC, Medium AUC, Large AUC)
cohort: A total of 23,577 pregnant Chinese women without gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) participated in the study.
finding: Higher AUC-OGTT patterns (MA and LA) were associated with a progressively increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preeclampsia, preterm birth, macrosomia, and cesarean delivery, in non-diabetic pregnant women.
mod_finding: Both medium and large AUC-OGTT patterns were associated with a higher risk of cesarean delivery.
